messages:
Rae: quick followup from the arch sync — I'm worried our current fallback playbook doesn't handle mid-canary precision tightenings. idea: bake a "lease" and rollback-safeguard into manifests so we can tighten budgets without breaking live canaries. thoughts?
Tom: +1. concretely: manifest has fields manifest_version, safety_budget, lease_grace_seconds, and forced_tightening_requires_ack. if safety_budget decreases, we honor existing leases until lease_grace_seconds expire.
Isha: ops concern: how do we detect that a tightening actually degrades user experience vs just improving cost? need per-manifest canary heuristics: sample_loss_delta, early_fallback_rate, regen_rate and a short smoke-check using quality_anchor.
Marco: also add a canary_window_count — only apply the new budget after M successful canary windows (e.g., 3) unless admin forces ack. avoids flip-flop from noisy samples.
Rae: streaming note: when we fallback mid-stream due to early-fallback triggers, clients break if we regenerate. propose default behavior: SWITCH_NO_REGEN but emit EVENT:REGEN_SUGGESTED with regen_reason and token_index. client may call regenerate=true on the next request. Document in the manifest a regen_policy enum: NONE | SUGGEST | AUTO_OPT_IN.
Tom: sample manifest snippet (for RFC):
```json
{ "model":"redwood-3b", "manifest_version":"v2", "precision_candidates":["fp32","fp8","int8"], "safety_budget":"0.015", "lease_grace_seconds":86400, "forced_tightening_requires_ack":true, "regen_policy":"SUGGEST", "canary_window_count":3, "quality_anchor_hash":"sha256:ffee..." }
```
Isha: telemetry hooks: emit MANIFEST_APPLIED, CANARY_WINDOW_PASSED, CANARY_WINDOW_FAILED, BUDGET_TIGHTENED_PENDING, BUDGET_ENFORCED, OVERRIDE_REVOKED. include manifest_version and lease_id as tags.
Marco: for Dedicated/Private, manifests must be signed and we need an admin acceptance API. also include an audit_log entry when lease is granted/renewed.
Rae: action items: Isha 1 define canary heuristics and events; Tom 1 add manifest lease semantics and error codes; Marco 1 draft admin acceptance API and audit flow. I'll draft the RFC with these and a short rollback playbook. ops-bot: RFC created: /rfc/manifest-lease-rollback-safety-v1 reviewers: Rae, Tom, Isha, Marco
